en: A standard wheelchair ramp has a 1:12 slope, meaning it rises exactly 1 centimeter for every 12 centimeters of horizontal length.
A skydiver falling belly-down reaches a maximum terminal velocity of about 195 kilometers per hour due to air friction.
The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so a 60-kilogram student would weigh only 10 kilograms on the lunar surface.
A small neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight in iron objects due to its strong magnetic field.
A single lightning bolt heats the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
Light travels at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second, taking approximately 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth from the Sun.
Sound travels through water at 1,480 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than its speed in air.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all metals at 3,422 degrees Celsius, making it perfect for incandescent light bulb filaments.
Dropping a small apple from a height of exactly 1 meter generates about 1 joule of kinetic energy upon impact.
A standard bicycle gear can increase pedaling distance by a factor of 5, turning one pedal rotation into 5 wheel rotations.
A black hole's gravity is so strong that not even light, traveling at 300,000 kilometers per second, can escape its pull.
The strongest continuous laboratory magnetic field is 45 Tesla, which is roughly 100,000 times stronger than Earth's natural magnetic field.
